Welcome to a channel dedicated to advancing veterinary knowledge for students, professionals, and enthusiasts!
​Our channel holds a rich archive of videos created by the dedicated BVSc & AH students of Lakhimpur College of Veterinary Science. As the channel evolves, we will be uploading new, specialized content designed exclusively to enhance veterinary education and academic understanding.
​Please Note: Everything shared on this channel is meant for learning. It is not intended to replace professional veterinary consultations, nor should it ever be used as a guide for medical treatment or applied research without rigorous verification.
​Keep learning and thanks for watching!
​Dr. S.N. Yadav
Assistant Professor, Veterinary Medicine
College of Veterinary Science, Khanapara
